summary: Core, CRM and HRM publish 17 native events (user updated/blocked/unblocked/deleted/role_assigned, role created/permission_granted, group created/member_added/member_removed, client deleted, chat message_added, employee created/updated) to the outbox in the transaction of the change and list them in the notification settings catalog; modules.Natives includes hrm.Natives, composables.AfterCommit defers the eventbus events of the services until the owning transaction commits, crm.client.updated.v1 names passport/pin edits and is no longer published for a no-op update, and chat appends lock the chat row.
